## 数据导入
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

mycsv <- read_csv("homework1/employee2018.csv")  
```

## 边界导入
```{r}
library(sf)
# my data is within a prac1_data folder.
shape <- st_read("homework1/statsnz-territorial-authority-2018-generalised-SHP/territorial-authority-2018-generalised.shp")

# dTolerance is the distance in which any “wiggles” will be straightened
shape_simple <- st_simplify(shape, dTolerance = 1000)
```

```{r}
## 数据检查
summary(shape)
summary(shape_simple)
```

```{r}
## 边界可视化并检查
library(sf)

shape_simple %>% 
  st_geometry() %>%
  plot()
```

```{r}
names(shape)
names(mycsv)
```

```{r}
shape2 <- shape_simple%>%
  merge(.,
        mycsv,
        by.x="TA2018_V_1", 
        by.y="Area_Description")
```

```{r}
shape2%>%
  head(., n=10)
```

```{r}
names(shape2)
```


```{r}
library(tmap)
tmap_mode("plot")
# change the fill to your column name if different
shape2 %>%
  qtm(.,fill = "Paid employee")
```
```{r}
shape2 %>%
  st_write(
    "homework1/paidemployee.gpkg",
    layer = "Newzeland_paidemployee",
    delete_dsn = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(RSQLite)

con <- dbConnect(
  RSQLite::SQLite(),
  dbname = "homework1/paidemployee.gpkg"
)

con %>%
  dbListTables()
```
